title: How to use My Tasks
summary: Your personal task list — switch views, group, filter and add tasks.

blocks.heading: My Tasks
paragraphs: My Tasks is your private to-do list. See it as a list, a board or a whiteboard, group and filter it however suits you, and add new tasks in a click.
The markings below point out the main controls.

blocks.alt: The My Tasks view with the view tabs, filter, focus-today and new-task controls highlighted
